mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1
